blocks.title: Organic redox reactions
blocks.text: Organic compounds wale oxidation-reduction reactions organic redox reactions hain. Un ki pehchan atoms ya bonds ka shamil hona ya hatna hai: organic oxidation mein aam taur par oxygen shamil hoti ya hydrogen hat-ti hai, aur organic reduction mein hydrogen shamil hoti ya oxygen hat-ti hai.

blocks.caption: Organic redox pehchanna
rows: ethanol se ethanoic acid; ethane ka jalna
ethene se ethane; ethanal se ethanol

blocks.prompt: Har ek ko oxidation ya reduction batayein: CH3CH=CH2 + H2 se CH3CH2CH3; CH3CH2OH se CH3CHO; alkene ki ozonolysis.
blocks.explanation: Propene ki hydrogenation hydrogen shamil karti hai: reduction. Ethanol se ethanal do hydrogens hatati hai: oxidation. Ozonolysis oxygen shamil karti aur C=C ko carbonyl compounds mein kaat-ti hai: oxidation.

items: Organic oxidation: O shamil ya H hatao; organic reduction: H shamil ya O hatao.
